app.name: Skycoin Wallet
backup.err-seed-api: The node does not show seeds. Start it with the INSECURE_WALLET_SEED API set to allow it.
backup.passphrase-info: This wallet has a seed passphrase. You need both the seed and this passphrase to recover it. The seed alone opens a different, empty wallet.
backup.seed-warning: Keep your seed somewhere safe and offline. Anyone who has it controls the wallet's coins.
backup.unencrypted-info: The node shows the seed only of an encrypted wallet. Encrypt the wallet first.
balance.pending-hint: Balance once the pending transactions confirm
bar.csrf: Security vulnerability: CSRF is not working, please exit immediately.
bar.no-peers: The node has no peer connections.
bar.pending: {{ count }} pending transaction(s). Data you see may not be updated.
bar.syncing: The node is synchronizing, {{ percent }}% ({{ current }} of {{ highest }} blocks). Data you see may not be updated.
bw.app-password-help: An app password encrypts the whole list of wallets kept in this browser, on top of each wallet's own password, and is asked for when a page opens.
bw.app-remove-help: The list is then stored without the app password. Each wallet stays encrypted with its own password.
bw.change-password-help: A wallet kept in this browser stays encrypted. A wallet stored without a password, as the classic wallet can, gets one here: leave the current password empty.
bw.create-help: The wallet is made and kept in this browser. Its seed is encrypted with the password and never leaves the browser.
bw.delete-confirm: Delete this wallet from this browser? Without its seed you will lose access to its coins.
bw.delete-help: Removes the wallet from this browser. Its coins stay on the blockchain, and the seed opens it again.
bw.erase-confirm: Erase every wallet kept in this browser? Without their seeds you will lose access to their coins. This cannot be undone.
bw.err-data: The browser sent wallet data the server could not read.
bw.err-exists: This wallet is already in this browser.
bw.err-mismatch: The transaction does not match what you asked to send, so it was not signed.
bw.err-password: Choose a password. A wallet kept in the browser is always encrypted.
bw.err-send-password: Enter the wallet password. The seed is decrypted in this browser to sign.
bw.err-storage: This browser's storage could not be read.
bw.err-unsupported: The classic wallet manages this kind of wallet.
bw.err-wrong-seed: This seed does not open this wallet.
bw.help: This node keeps no wallets. These wallets are kept in this browser, shared with the classic wallet. Their seeds and keys never leave the browser.
bw.insecure: The wallet needs a secure page, and this browser tab is not one. Open it at http://localhost on the machine that serves it, reach that machine through an SSH tunnel (for example ssh -L 8000:localhost:8000 user@host, then http://localhost:8000), use https, or add the address under "Insecure origins treated as secure" in chrome://flags.
bw.locked: The wallets in this browser are locked with an app password.
bw.missing: This browser has no such wallet.
bw.none: There are no wallets in this browser yet. If you don't have a wallet, create a new one and write its seed down. If you already have one, load it with its seed.
bw.passphrase: Seed passphrase (only if the wallet has one)
bw.password-help: The seed is stored encrypted with this password, and sending needs it. A lost password can only be recovered with the seed.
bw.temp-help: The wallet is kept only in this browser tab, still encrypted with its password, and is gone when the tab closes. You will need the seed to open it again.
bw.title: Wallets in this browser
create.err-not-bip39: This is not a standard 12 or 24 word seed. Check the words, or for a deterministic wallet tick the box for a non-standard seed.
create.err-password-confirm: The two passwords do not match.
create.err-seed: There is no seed. Generate one first.
create.err-seed-confirm: The seed you typed does not match. Check every word.
create.label: Name
create.nonstandard: This is not a standard 12 or 24 word seed. Only a deterministic wallet can use one.
create.passphrase-help: An optional passphrase adds an extra layer of security. You will need both the seed and the passphrase to recover the wallet. It is used exactly as typed.
create.password-help: With a password the seed and keys are encrypted on the node, and sending needs the password. A lost password can only be recovered with the seed.
create.seed-confirm: Type the seed again to confirm you saved it
create.seed-warning: They are shown only this once. Anyone who has them can spend the coins, and without them a lost wallet cannot be restored.
create.seed-warning-title: Write these words down, in order, and keep them offline.
create.temp-help: The node keeps the wallet in memory only, without a password, and forgets it when it restarts. You will need the seed to open it again.
create.type-pq-info: A post-quantum wallet signs with ML-DSA-44, so its addresses stay safe against quantum computers after a spend. They only receive coins on chains that have reached the post-quantum address fork.
history.none-filter: There are no transactions matching the current filter criteria.
history.search: Search by transaction ID or address
joint.change-hint: Needed only when the outputs do not use all input coins.
joint.create-text: Spend your outputs and the other party's in one transaction, with the coins and coin hours of every output set by hand. Each party then signs only their own inputs.
joint.created: Unsigned transaction. Send it to the other party, and review and sign it yourself.
joint.err-input-left-out: The node left out some of the outputs because fewer were enough. Raise the output coins or hours so every output is needed.
joint.err-need-inputs: Choose at least one output to spend.
joint.err-need-outputs: Every output needs an address, coins above zero and a whole number of hours.
joint.err-nothing-to-sign: This wallet owns none of the unsigned inputs.
joint.err-unknown-outputs: Some of the other party's outputs are not unspent outputs on this node.
joint.own-signed: This wallet has already signed its inputs. Send the transaction to the other party to sign theirs.
joint.owns-none: This wallet owns none of the inputs, so it has nothing to sign.
joint.their-outputs-hint: Paste the other party's output hashes, separated by commas or spaces
joint.title: Joint transaction
pending.remove-confirm: Are you sure you want to remove this pending transaction from the local pool? This cannot be undone.
qr.invalid: Some values are not valid and were left out.
qr.title: Address
reset.passphrase: Seed passphrase (leave empty if the wallet has none)
reset.password: New password (leave empty if you want the wallet not to be encrypted)
reset.title: Reset password
send.advanced-options: Advanced options: change, hours, sources, bulk send
send.all-help: Fill in every confirmed coin of the wallet
send.bulk-empty: There is no text to process.
send.bulk-help: To send to several destinations at once, type each address, coin amount and hour amount (optional) on a line, separated by commas. The lines replace the destinations above. Setting hours on the lines sets them by hand.
send.bulk-inconsistent: If you set the hours for one destination, you must set them for all of them.
send.bulk-invalid: Each line must be an address and a coin amount, and optionally an hour amount, separated by commas.
send.change-default: An unused address of this wallet
send.change-help: Left empty, the change goes to an address of this wallet that has never been used. Reusing an address links your payments together.
send.err-change: The change address is not a valid address.
send.err-coins: Enter an amount of coins greater than zero.
send.err-hours: With manual hours, every destination needs a whole number of hours.
send.err-no-coins: This address holds no confirmed coins.
send.err-pending: This address has a transaction waiting to be confirmed. Try again once it confirms.
send.err-share: The share factor must be a number from 0 to 1.
send.err-source: A chosen address is not in this wallet.
send.err-to: That is not a valid address.
send.from-help: Limit the addresses the coins may come from. Leave all unticked to let the node choose.
send.hours-auto: Automatic: send this share of the hours left after the fee
send.hours-manual: Manual: set the hours of each destination
send.link-done: The form has been filled in with the data of the payment link.
send.link-help: Paste a link sent to you requesting coins, such as skycoin:ADDRESS?amount=1. The first destination will be filled in with its data.
send.link-invalid: This is not a valid payment link.
send.move-help: This address has spent before, so its public key is on the blockchain. Every coin it holds moves to an address of this wallet that has never been used.
send.move-title: Move coins to a new address
send.note-help: Kept in this browser only, and shown in the history.
send.outputs-help: Limit the outputs to spend. When any is ticked, the address choice above is ignored.
send.sent: Sent. The transaction is waiting to be confirmed.
send.title: Send
send.unsigned-help: Make the transaction without signing it, to sign elsewhere
send.warn-change-foreign: The change address is not in this wallet. The change will leave the wallet.
send.warn-change-reused: The change address has been used before. Reusing an address links your payments together.
send.warn-to-own: This is an address of this wallet.
send.warn-to-reused: The address you send to has received coins before. Reusing an address links payments together.
send.warn-to-spent: The address you send to has spent coins before, so its public key is public. Ask the recipient for a new address.
settings.backup-help: Save the wallets' addresses and see their seeds.
settings.outputs-help: The unspent outputs that make up each address balance.
settings.pending-help: Transactions the node has not put in a block yet.
settings.status-help: Sync, peers and the coin supply.
tx.done-signed: Signed. Copy the transaction to the next signer, or broadcast it once every input is signed.
tx.err-invalid: This is not a valid transaction.
tx.note-help: Personal note, kept in this browser
tx.page-help: Paste a transaction to review it: sign an unsigned one with a wallet of this node, co-sign a joint one, or broadcast one that is fully signed.
tx.sign-warning: Check every output before signing. Your signature commits you to exactly these outputs, and anyone may broadcast the transaction once every input is signed.
tx.wallet-help: The wallet whose inputs to sign. Leave it empty to only review or broadcast.
wallet.decrypt-help: The node will keep this wallet without a password, and anyone with access to it can send its coins.
wallet.done-decrypted: The wallet is no longer encrypted.
wallet.encrypt-help: Only someone with the password can send from an encrypted wallet. If you forget the password, you can reset it with the seed, so keep the seed somewhere safe first.
wallet.exposed-banner: {{ count }} address(es) in this wallet hold coins but have already sent coins, so their public keys are on the blockchain. A future quantum computer could steal these coins. Send them to a new address of this wallet.
wallet.exposed-help: This address has spent before, so its public key is on the blockchain, and it still holds coins.
wallet.name: Name
wallet.scan-gap: Stop after this many unused addresses in a row
wallet.scan-help: Finds the already used addresses of this wallet which are missing from the list.
wallet.temp-help: Kept in the node's memory only, it is gone when the node restarts.
wallets.api-off: This node does not keep wallets, because its wallet API is turned off. Wallets kept in the browser are in the classic wallet.
wallets.label: Name
wallets.none: There are no wallets on this node yet. If you don't have a wallet, create a new one and write its seed down. If you already have one, load it with its seed.
xpub.chains-help: Keys one level below the account key, each for one chain only. Do not give these to the reward system.
xpub.help: The account extended public key, at depth 3. The Skywire reward system asks for this key. It reveals the account's addresses and balances but cannot spend.
xpub.title: Account xPub
